name: Bleed No More Bandage
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 3rd; Slot none; Price 270 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

When applied to a bleeding wound (with a DC 10 Heal check), the magic of this thick, 3-foot-long gauze bandage will cause all open wounds on the target creature to stop bleeding. If the target was suffering from bleed damage, no more damage will be taken due to bleeding. The bandage does not restore any lost hp due to bleeding or otherwise.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, bleed no more; Cost 135 gp.
